name: Cosmetics Holder
story: Organize your eyeshadows, your make up brushes, even a lipstick or two in this keeper.  Or, if you are an artist, this doubles as a holder for pens, pencils, paint brushes.  Your imagination is the limit!
snippet: A multi sectioned  holder for makeup, etc.
